# Shared cases: the order of the search's mixed results.
#
# Replayed by both implementations, so they cannot drift apart:
#   - native/linthra_core/src/search_rank_cases_test.rs (Rust)
#   - test/core/catalog/search_rank_cases_test.dart (Dart)
#
# One case per line, fields separated by a single TAB. `#` starts a comment.
#
#   <query>  <results>  <expected order>
#
# results: kind:name entries separated by `|`, kind being artist, album or
#          song. The expected order lists their positions (from 0), best first.
#
# Tiers, by the result's own name: the name is the query word for word; every
# word typed is a whole word of it; every word typed starts a word of it; the
# same with typos; not at all (found by another field). Within a tier: artist,
# album, song, then the order given.

metallica	song:Battery|album:Master of Puppets|artist:Metallica	2 1 0
metallica	song:Metallica|album:Metallica|artist:Metallica	2 1 0
master of puppets	song:Master of Puppets|album:Master of Puppets|song:Battery	1 0 2
puppets	song:Master of Puppets|album:Master of Puppets|artist:Metallica	1 0 2
master	song:Master Blaster|album:Masterpiece|artist:Mastermind	0 2 1
one	song:One|song:Someone Like You|album:One by One	0 2 1
metalica	artist:Metallica|song:Battery	0 1
metal	artist:Metallica|song:Metal Heart|album:Heavy Metal	2 1 0
bjork	song:Jóga|artist:Björk	1 0
bjork homogenic	song:Jóga|album:Homogenic	1 0
a	song:A|artist:Abba|album:A	2 0 1
zzz	song:B|artist:A|album:C	1 2 0
